title: Lesson 17 - License types to standard/custom objects: CRM tiers, platform license, object access per license
description: Given a customer scenario, recommend the appropriate combination of Salesforce license types to effectively leverage standard and custom objects to meet business needs, including how CRM-edition licenses differ from platform licenses in their access to standard and custom objects.

questions.question: A warehouse operations team needs to create and edit a custom 'Shipment__c' object but has no need for Accounts or Opportunities. Which license is most cost-effective?
questions.explanation: Platform licenses grant custom-object access without the cost of core CRM objects; Sales/Service (A, B) are unnecessary and Partner Community (D) is for external partners.

questions.question: Which TWO statements about license types are TRUE?
options: Platform licenses can access Opportunities and Cases
CRM licenses grant access to core standard objects plus custom objects
Community licenses are designed for external users with restricted object access
All CRM editions expose exactly the same standard objects
questions.explanation: CRM licenses include core standard objects plus custom (B) and community licenses are external/restricted (C); Platform licenses cannot access core CRM objects (A false) and edition availability varies (D false).

questions.question: An integration user must call REST APIs to load data into custom objects only. Which license minimizes cost while meeting the need?
questions.explanation: Platform/Integration licenses serve API-only users on custom objects; full CRM (A) is wasteful and community licenses (C, D) are for external persons with restricted access.
